title: AI as Writing Assistant
summary: AI speeds up drafting — you edit at least three lines to keep your voice.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **AI (artificial intelligence)** **as a writing assistant** — **not a replacement for you**.
- **AI** **accelerates work** — **but if you let it do everything**, **it produces generic text** **that sounds like others**.
- **What you need to do:** **Use it as a draft** — **then edit it yourself** **to keep your voice authentic**.
bullets: **What will you understand?** **AI (artificial intelligence)** **as a writing assistant** — **not a replacement for you**.
**AI** **accelerates work** — **but if you let it do everything**, **it produces generic text** **that sounds like others**.
**What you need to do:** **Use it as a draft** — **then edit it yourself** **to keep your voice authentic**.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: The Problem
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Copying AI text as is** **kills your personality**.
- **When you publish** **without editing** — **the audience feels** **the text is artificial and repetitive**.
- **The real difference:** **Your examples**, **your style**, **and your word choices**.
bullets: **Copying AI text as is** **kills your personality**.
**When you publish** **without editing** — **the audience feels** **the text is artificial and repetitive**.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: Write Clear Context and Then Edit the Text
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Start with a Prompt** **that includes the audience, purpose, tone, and content length** — this is a **clear Context**.
- **Request a quick initial Draft** — **not a perfect final text**.
- **Then edit at least 3 lines yourself:** **a stronger opening**, **an example from you**, **and a conclusion in your style** — **Edit Pass**.
- **Any sentence** **that doesn’t sound like you** — **change it immediately** **even if it’s grammatically correct**.

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.subtitle: Direct Copy or Conscious Editing?
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Weak Style | Stronger Style |
|----------------|----------------|
| **General Prompt** **then publish the text as is** — **cold and similar content** | **Prompt with clear Context** **then manually edit the key sentences** — **closer to your true voice** |

sections.heading: Glossary
sections.subtitle: 3 Terms You Will Always Use
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| **Context** | **The information** **you provide to the AI** **to understand your request accurately** | **Audience:** **Small business owners** |
| **Draft** | **The first rough version** **of the text before refinement** | **An 80-word draft** **for a short video** |
| **Edit Pass** | **A human editing round** **to bring the text closer to your voice** | **Changing the opening** **and adding a personal example** |

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quick Confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
> **Quiz key (unchanged):** correctIndex: 1

**Question:** **You want to write a short video in your true voice with the help of AI** — **which choice is more accurate?**

Request a complete text** **and publish it as is to save time.
**Write a clear Context** — **get a Draft** — **then edit at least 3 lines in your way**.
Use AI to correct punctuation only** **without any draft.

**Explanation:** **This approach** **balances speed** **with maintaining your personality** **in writing**.

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: Write a Draft with AI and Then Edit 3 Lines
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **Two clear steps:** **a draft from AI** — **then your human editing** **on 3 lines** **to show your personality**.

**Submission:** Complete Prompt · AI draft as is · 3 lines you edited · Two lines explaining why the edits are closer to your voice.

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Quality of Context | 40% | **The prompt includes a clear audience, purpose, and tone** |
| Personal Editing | 60% | **3 clear actual edits** **with a convincing reason** |
